headline: Dr. Lal Path Labs Ltd.: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Dr. Lal Path Labs Ltd.
detail: General Updates - Dr. Lal Path Labs Ltd. has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 70% stake in SN Genelab Private Limited ( S N Gene ) from its existing Shareholders. Post acquisition, S N Gene shall become a Subsidiary of the Company
